info.disambiguation: LA punk band, includes Flea & Chuck Biscuits
info.bio: Fear is an American punk rock band from Los Angeles, California, formed in 1977. The band is credited for helping to shape the sound and style of hardcore punk. The group came to national attention after an infamous 1981 performance on Saturday Night Live. Frontman Lee Ving has been the band's only constant member. Since its formation, the band has gone through various lineup changes, and at one point, featured Flea of the Red Hot Chili Peppers on bass.

scenes.name: Hardcore
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El punk como «violento, rápido y ruidoso» tarda en conquistar EE UU, pero cuando lo hace el hardcore se convierte durante dos décadas en el idioma nacional de millones de chavales. Misfits y el «scum-rock»; el crossover punk-metal (Suicidal Tendencies, Corrosion Of Conformity, Agnostic Front); Mission Of Burma en Boston. Washington: Bad Brains (reggae, funk y metal diez años por delante), Minor Threat (el «straight-edge») y Rites Of Spring, inventores del emo-core. San Francisco: Dead Kennedys de Jello Biafra, D.R.I. (thrash antes que Metallica), Flipper. Los «beach punks» de Los Ángeles: Germs, X, Black Flag (Damaged), Descendents, Gun Club (Fire Of Love), Bad Religion. El jazz-core de Minutemen y Saccharine Trust; en el Medio Oeste, Husker Du y Replacements cambian el hardcore para siempre; en Chicago, Naked Raygun y Big Black de Steve Albini; en Europa, The Ex y los italianos CCCP.

podcast.title: Association with Slam Dancing
podcast.body: Fear is mentioned alongside Black Flag as bands associated with the Orange County punks who were instrumental in the emergence of slam dancing in the late 1970s. Their shows were part of the intense, physical environment where this dance style developed. "Black flag, fear, bands like that. Playing at clubs like The Cookus Nest in Costa Mesa, which has gone down on history as the birthplace of slam dancing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Cuckoo's Nest Performances
podcast.body: Fear was one of the bands that played at The Cuckoo's Nest, a club that became a central location for the early development of slam dancing and moshing. "One of the bands who played the Kuku's Nest was Fear."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Formation and Evolution
podcast.body: Fear was formed in 1977 and continues to exist. The band started as basic punks but evolved to form the foundations of California hardcore punk, a genre deeply intertwined with the origins of moshing. "Fear was formed in 1977, still exists today, and at one point they featured a bass player named Flea."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
